empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when the agent should apply this skill and what to do. The description is the skill's interface.
editor.bodyHint: Markdown. Becomes a separate block in the agent's system prompt.
editor.changeNoteHint: Saved with the new version in the history.
editor.deleteConfirm: It is removed from every agent that uses it. This cannot be undone.

errors.name: Name is required.
errors.bodyLong: The body is too long (max 20,000 characters).

stats.note: Based on runs from the last 30 days where this skill was in the prompt. A correlation, not proof.
stats.noAgents: No agent uses this skill yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.diffLabel: Changes from v{version} to the current body
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This saves its body as a new version.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: A markdown file, or a .zip containing a SKILL.md
import.previewSubtitle: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.drop: Drop a .md or .zip here, or click to choose
import.dropHint: Up to 512 KB. Only the SKILL.md is read.
import.badType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.trustNotice: A foreign skill is foreign instructions in your agent's prompt. Read the body below before you save it.
import.nameConflict: A skill with this name already exists — rename it to continue.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A reusable block for agents' system prompts: a name, a directive description, a type and a markdown body.
